author: artlbv
body:
Backport of #52426 to `CMSSW_17_0_X`. See that PR for the description and the validation.

One deviation, isolated in the last commit: `P2GTCandidate::isolationPT()` came in with #51804 and is not on this branch, so `L1GTgmtTkMuon.iso` and `.relIso` are built from `hwIsolationPT_toInt()` and `scale_parameter.isolationPT_lsb`  the same form the `gtTkEleTable`/`gtTkPhoTable` entries here already use, and numerically identical.
title: [Backport of #52426] [L1T] Phase2 L1Nano: fix TkMuon isolation branches, drop the unfilled hwIso from the SA muon tables
